dreams.expected: You walk the quays in the fog, looking for the Kempen road home, and every lamp you pass goes out behind you. Somewhere a ship's bell rings, and you wake before you can count the strokes.
A hand reaches into your coat, and when you turn there is only fog, and the fog is laughing. Somewhere a ship's bell rings, and you wake before you can count the strokes.
You carry sacks up a gangway that never ends; each one is lighter than the last, and at the top your mother counts them. Somewhere a ship's bell rings, and you wake before you can count the strokes.
